ProphetX | Multiple Roles | REMOTE (US) | Full-time

ProphetX is one of the fastest growing prediction markets in America. Fully CFTC regulated and particularly big in the sports area, we are looking to fill a number of roles across engineering and product.

Among others, we are looking for:

Engineering Manager

Staff Backend

Senior Backend

Staff DevOps (note this hasn't appeared on the job site yet, check in a day or so). This one should be open for EU timezones as well.

It's not terribly important which stack you are in, but we are building some low latency, high throughput distributed systems.

Please mention Hacker News so I can show everyone the wonderful quality of candidates available on this board.

https://prophetexchange.pinpointhq.com/
